<n>37:11</n> Cor meum conturbátum est, derelíquit me virtus mea: * et lumen oculórum meórum, et ipsum non est mecum.
<n>37:12</n> Amíci mei, et próximi mei * advérsum me appropinquavérunt, et stetérunt.
<n>37:12</n> Et qui juxta me erant, de longe stetérunt: * et vim faciébant qui quærébant ánimam meam.
<n>37:13</n> Et qui inquirébant mala mihi, locúti sunt vanitátes: * et dolos tota die meditabántur.
<n>37:14</n> Ego autem tamquam surdus non audiébam: * et sicut mutus non apériens os suum.
<n>37:15</n> Et factus sum sicut homo non áudiens: * et non habens in ore suo redargutiónes.
<n>37:16</n> Quóniam in te, Dómine, sperávi: * tu exáudies me, Dómine, Deus meus.
<n>37:17</n> Quia dixi: Nequándo supergáudeant mihi inimíci mei: * et dum commovéntur pedes mei, super me magna locúti sunt.
<n>37:18</n> Quóniam ego in flagélla parátus sum: * et dolor meus in conspéctu meo semper.
<n>37:19</n> Quóniam iniquitátem meam annuntiábo: * et cogitábo pro peccáto meo.
<n>37:20</n> Inimíci autem mei vivunt, et confirmáti sunt super me: * et multiplicáti sunt qui odérunt me iníque.
<n>37:21</n> Qui retríbuunt mala pro bonis, detrahébant mihi: * quóniam sequébar bonitátem.
<n>37:22</n> Ne derelínquas me, Dómine, Deus meus: * ne discésseris a me.
<n>37:23</n> Inténde in adjutórium meum, * Dómine, Deus, salútis meæ.
03.fb9cb51389:
<n>37:2</n> Rebuke me not, O Lord, in thy indignation; * nor chastise me in thy wrath.
<n>37:3</n> For thy arrows are fastened in me: * and thy hand hath been strong upon me.
<n>37:4</n> There is no health in my flesh, because of thy wrath: * there is no peace for my bones, because of my sins.
<n>37:5</n> For my iniquities are gone over my head: * and as a heavy burden are become heavy upon me.
<n>37:6</n> My sores are putrified and corrupted, * because of my foolishness.
<n>37:7</n> I am become miserable, and am bowed down even to the end: * I walked sorrowful all the day long.
<n>37:8</n> For my loins are filled with illusions; * and there is no health in my flesh.
<n>37:9</n> I am afflicted and humbled exceedingly: * I roared with the groaning of my heart.
<n>37:10</n> Lord, all my desire is before thee, * and my groaning is not hidden from thee.
<n>37:11</n> My heart is troubled, my strength hath left me, * and the light of my eyes itself is not with me.
<n>37:12</n> My friends and my neighbours * have drawn near, and stood against me.
<n>37:12</n> And they that were near me stood afar off: * and they that sought my soul used violence.
<n>37:13</n> And they that sought evils to me spoke vain things, * and studied deceits all the day long.
<n>37:14</n> But I, as a deaf man, heard not: * and as a dumb man not opening his mouth.
<n>37:15</n> And I became as a man that heareth not: * and that hath no reproofs in his mouth.
<n>37:16</n> For in thee, O Lord, have I hoped: * thou wilt hear me, O Lord my God.
<n>37:17</n> For I said: Lest at any time my enemies rejoice over me: * and whilst my feet are moved, they speak great things against me.
<n>37:18</n> For I am ready for scourges: * and my sorrow is continually before me.
<n>37:19</n> For I will declare my iniquity: * and I will think for my sin.
<n>37:20</n> But my enemies live, and are stronger than I: * and they that hate me wrongfully are multiplied.
<n>37:21</n> They that render evil for good, have detracted me, * because I followed goodness.
<n>37:22</n> Forsake me not, O Lord my God: * do not thou depart from me.
<n>37:23</n> Attend unto my help, * O Lord, the God of my salvation.
03.8e7431a003:
<n>30:2</n> In te, Dómine, sperávi, non confúndar in ætérnum: * in justítia tua líbera me.
<n>30:3</n> Inclína ad me aurem tuam, * accélera ut éruas me.
<n>30:3</n> Esto mihi in Deum protectórem, et in domum refúgii: * ut salvum me fácias.
<n>30:4</n> Quóniam fortitúdo mea, et refúgium meum es tu: * et propter nomen tuum dedúces me, et enútries me.
<n>30:5</n> Edúces me de láqueo hoc, quem abscondérunt mihi: * quóniam tu es protéctor meus.
<n>30:6</n> In manus tuas comméndo spíritum meum: * redemísti me, Dómine, Deus veritátis.
<n>30:7</n> Odísti observántes vanitátes, * supervácue.
<n>30:7</n> Ego autem in Dómino sperávi: * exsultábo, et lætábor in misericórdia tua.
<n>30:8</n> Quóniam respexísti humilitátem meam, * salvásti de necessitátibus ánimam meam.
<n>30:9</n> Nec conclusísti me in mánibus inimíci: * statuísti in loco spatióso pedes meos.
<n>30:10</n> Miserére mei, Dómine, quóniam tríbulor: * conturbátus est in ira óculus meus, ánima mea, et venter meus:
<n>30:11</n> Quóniam defécit in dolóre vita mea: * et anni mei in gemítibus.
<n>30:11</n> Infirmáta est in paupertáte virtus mea: * et ossa mea conturbáta sunt.
<n>30:12</n> Super omnes inimícos meos factus sum oppróbrium et vicínis meis valde: * et timor notis meis.
<n>30:12</n> Qui vidébant me, foras fugérunt a me: * oblivióni datus sum, tamquam mórtuus a corde.
<n>30:13</n> Factus sum tamquam vas pérditum: * quóniam audívi vituperatiónem multórum commorántium in circúitu.
<n>30:14</n> In eo dum convenírent simul advérsum me, * accípere ánimam meam consiliáti sunt.
<n>30:15</n> Ego autem in te sperávi, Dómine: * dixi: Deus meus es tu: in mánibus tuis sortes meæ.
<n>30:16</n> Éripe me de manu inimicórum meórum, * et a persequéntibus me.
<n>30:17</n> Illústra fáciem tuam super servum tuum, salvum me fac in misericórdia tua: * Dómine, non confúndar, quóniam invocávi te.
<n>30:18</n> Erubéscant ímpii, et deducántur in inférnum: * muta fiant lábia dolósa.
<n>30:19</n> Quæ loquúntur advérsus justum iniquitátem: * in supérbia, et in abusióne.
<n>30:20</n> Quam magna multitúdo dulcédinis tuæ, Dómine, * quam abscondísti timéntibus te.
<n>30:20</n> Perfecísti eis, qui sperant in te, * in conspéctu filiórum hóminum.
<n>30:21</n> Abscóndes eos in abscóndito faciéi tuæ * a conturbatióne hóminum.
<n>30:21</n> Próteges eos in tabernáculo tuo * a contradictióne linguárum.
<n>30:22</n> Benedíctus Dóminus: * quóniam mirificávit misericórdiam suam mihi in civitáte muníta.
<n>30:23</n> Ego autem dixi in excéssu mentis meæ: * Projéctus sum a fácie oculórum tuórum.
<n>30:23</n> Ídeo exaudísti vocem oratiónis meæ, * dum clamárem ad te.
<n>30:24</n> Dilígite Dóminum omnes sancti ejus: * quóniam veritátem requíret Dóminus, et retríbuet abundánter faciéntibus supérbiam.
<n>30:25</n> Viríliter ágite, et confortétur cor vestrum, * omnes, qui sperátis in Dómino.
03.8968fc2280:
<n>30:2</n> In thee, O Lord, have I hoped, let me never be confounded: * deliver me in thy justice.
<n>30:3</n> Bow down thy ear to me: * make haste to deliver me.
<n>30:3</n> Be thou unto me a God, a protector, and a house of refuge, * to save me.
<n>30:4</n> For thou art my strength and my refuge; * and for thy name’s sake thou wilt lead me, and nourish me.
<n>30:5</n> Thou wilt bring me out of this snare, which they have hidden for me: * for thou art my protector.
<n>30:6</n> Into thy hands I commend my spirit: * thou hast redeemed me, O Lord, the God of truth.
<n>30:7</n> Thou hast hated them that regard vanities, * to no purpose.
<n>30:7</n> But I have hoped in the Lord: * I will be glad and rejoice in thy mercy.
<n>30:8</n> For thou hast regarded my humility, * thou hast saved my soul out of distresses.
<n>30:9</n> And thou hast not shut me up in the hands of the enemy: * thou hast set my feet in a spacious place.
<n>30:10</n> Have mercy on me, O Lord, for I am afflicted: * my eye is troubled with wrath, my soul, and my belly:
<n>30:11</n> For my life is wasted with grief: * and my years in sighs.
<n>30:11</n> My strength is weakened through poverty * and my bones are disturbed.
<n>30:12</n> I am become a reproach among all my enemies, and very much to my neighbours; * and a fear to my acquaintance.
<n>30:12</n> They that saw me without fled from me. * I am forgotten as one dead from the heart.
<n>30:13</n> I am become as a vessel that is destroyed. * For I have heard the blame of many that dwell round about.
<n>30:14</n> While they assembled together against me, * they consulted to take away my life.
<n>30:15</n> But I have put my trust in thee, O Lord: * I said: Thou art my God. My lots are in thy hands.
<n>30:16</n> Deliver me out of the hands of my enemies; * and from them that persecute me.
<n>30:17</n> Make thy face to shine upon thy servant; save me in thy mercy. * Let me not be confounded, O Lord, for I have called upon thee.
<n>30:18</n> Let the wicked be ashamed, and be brought down to hell. * Let deceitful lips be made dumb.
<n>30:19</n> Which speak iniquity against the just, * with pride and abuse.
<n>30:20</n> How great is the multitude of thy sweetness, O Lord, * which thou hast hidden for them that fear thee!
<n>30:20</n> Which thou hast wrought for them that hope in thee, * in the sight of the sons of men.
<n>30:21</n> Thou shalt hide them in the secret of thy face, * from the disturbance of men.
<n>30:21</n> Thou shalt protect them in thy tabernacle * from the contradiction of tongues.
<n>30:22</n> Blessed be the Lord, * for he hath shewn his wonderful mercy to me in a fortified city.
<n>30:23</n> But I said in the excess of my mind: * I am cast away from before thy eyes.
<n>30:23</n> Therefore thou hast heard the voice of my prayer, * when I cried to thee.
<n>30:24</n> O love the Lord, all ye his saints: * for the Lord will require truth, and will repay them abundantly that act proudly.
<n>30:25</n> Do ye manfully, and let your heart be strengthened, * all ye that hope in the Lord.
